newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African wool prices mixed at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: South African wool prices mixed at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices were mixed at the season's weekly auction, the Wool Board said. 11,262 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 97.5 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron fell 3.6 percent, 21 micron rose 1.0 percent. 22 micron fell 1.8 percent, 23 micron rose 0.4 percent, 24 micron rose 0.8 percent and 25 micron was unquoted.
Prices for Merino bellies rose 0.6 percent, Merino lambs rose 0.1 percent and Merino locks fell 2.4 percent.
The offering included 1,644 bales of other white wool, no quotes for Ciskei Transkei and Lesotho wools and 876 bales of Coarse & Coloured wool.

All bales of 25 micron offered, sold 100 percent. Of 273 bales of 20 micron offered, 96.3 percent were sold, of 910 bales of 21 micron offered 90.6 percent were sold, of 1,946 bales of 22 micron offered 96.1 percent were sold, of 2,150 bales of 23 micron offered, 99,9 percent were sold and of 1,186 bales of 24 micron offered 99.6 percent were sold.
The next sale will take place on October 02, offering about 10,000 bales.
